text_en: Now when David settled in his house, David said to the prophet Nathan, “I am living in a house of cedar, but the ark of the covenant of the Lord is under a tent. ”
text_cn: 当达味住在宫殿时，对纳堂先知说：“看，我住在香柏木的宫殿里，上主的结约之柜却在帐幕里。”

text_en: Nathan said to David, “Do all that you have in mind, for God is with you. ”
text_cn: 纳堂回答达味说：“你心中打算的，你全可照办，因为上主与你同在。”

text_en: But that same night the word of the Lord came to Nathan, saying:
text_cn: 但是，当夜就有天主的话传于纳堂说：

text_en: Go and tell my servant David: Thus says the Lord : You shall not build me a house to live in.
text_cn: “你去告诉我的仆人达味，上主这样说：不是你要为我建筑殿宇居住。

text_en: For I have not lived in a house since the day I brought out Israel to this very day, but I have lived in a tent and a tabernacle.
text_cn: 我自从领以色列上来那天起，直到今日，从没有住过殿宇，只从这帐棚到那帐棚，从这会幕到那会幕。

text_en: Wherever I have moved about among all Israel, did I ever speak a word with any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to shepherd my people, saying, Why have you not built me a house of cedar?
text_cn: 在我与全以色列同行时，我何尝向我立为牧养我民以色列的一个民长说过：你们为什么不为我建造一座香柏木的殿宇？

text_en: Now therefore thus you shall say to my servant David: Thus says the Lord of hosts: I took you from the pasture, from following the sheep, to be ruler over my people Israel;
text_cn: 现在你要对我的仆人达味说：万军的上主这样说：是我拣选你离开牧场，离开放羊的事，作我民以色列的领袖。

text_en: and I have been with you wherever you went, and have cut off all your enemies before you; and I will make for you a name, like the name of the great ones of the earth.
text_cn: 你不论往哪里去，我总是同你在一起，由你面前消灭你的一切仇敌。我要使你成名，像世上出名的大人物。

text_en: I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, so that they may live in their own place, and be disturbed no more; and evildoers shall wear them down no more, as they did formerly,
text_cn: 我要为我民以色列安置一个地方，栽培他们，在那里久住，再也不受惊扰，再也不像先前受恶人的蹂躏，

text_en: from the time that I appointed judges over my people Israel; and I will subdue all your enemies. Moreover I declare to you that the Lord will build you a house.
text_cn: 有如我为我民以色列立民长的时候一样；我要降服你的一切仇敌。并且我告诉你：上主必要为你建立家室。

text_en: When your days are fulfilled to go to be with your ancestors, I will raise up your offspring after you, one of your own sons, and I will establish his kingdom.
text_cn: 及至你日子满期，到你祖先那里去时，我必在你以后给你兴起一个后裔，即你所生的一个儿子，巩固他的王权。

text_en: He shall build a house for me, and I will establish his throne forever.
text_cn: 他要为我建造殿宇，我要巩固他的王位，直到永远。

text_en: I will be a father to him, and he shall be a son to me. I will not take my steadfast love from him, as I took it from him who was before you,
text_cn: 我要作他的父亲，他要作我的儿子；我决不使我的宠爱离弃他，有如离弃你以前那一位；

text_en: but I will confirm him in my house and in my kingdom forever, and his throne shall be established forever.
text_cn: 反要使他坚立在我的家和我的国中，至于永远；他的王位永固不移。”

text_en: In accordance with all these words and all this vision, Nathan spoke to David.
text_cn: 纳堂便照这一切话，将整个启示告诉了达味。

text_en: Then King David went in and sat before the Lord , and said, “Who am I, O Lord God, and what is my house, that you have brought me thus far?
text_cn: 达味就进去，端坐在上主面前说：“上主，天主！我是谁？我的家族又算什么，你竟领我到了这个地步！

text_en: And even this was a small thing in your sight, O God; you have also spoken of your servant’s house for a great while to come. You regard me as someone of high rank, O Lord God!
text_cn: 天主，这在你眼里还以为太小，而你又说明了你仆人家族的未来远景，竟视我有如一个高贵的人，上主，天主！

text_en: And what more can David say to you for honoring your servant? You know your servant.
text_cn: 为了你加于你仆人达味的光荣，我还有什么话可向你说，你认识你的仆人。

text_en: For your servant’s sake, O Lord , and according to your own heart, you have done all these great deeds, making known all these great things.
text_cn: 上主！你为了你的仆人，按照你的心意，成就了这些伟大的事，为将这些伟大的事彰显出来。

text_en: There is no one like you, O Lord , and there is no God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
text_cn: 上主！照我们耳朵所听到的，没有谁能与你相比；除你以外，也没有别的神。

text_en: Who is like your people Israel, one nation on the earth whom God went to redeem to be his people, making for yourself a name for great and terrible things, in driving out nations before your people whom you redeemed from Egypt?
text_cn: 世上又有那一个民族，能比得上你的民族以色列？天主竟亲自将他们解救出来，作为自己的民族，为使你成名，就在你从埃及解救出来的人民前，行了大而可畏的奇事驱散了异民；

text_en: And you made your people Israel to be your people forever; and you, O Lord , became their God.
text_cn: 你使你的民族以色列永远作你的民族，你，上主做他们的天主。

text_en: “And now, O Lord , as for the word that you have spoken concerning your servant and concerning his house, let it be established forever, and do as you have promised.
text_cn: 上主！现在求你永远坚持你论及你仆人，及他的家室所说的话，照你所说的话履行吧！

text_en: Thus your name will be established and magnified forever in the saying, ‘The Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, is Israel’s God’; and the house of your servant David will be established in your presence.
text_cn: 愿这话坚定不移，愿你的名永远受尊崇，人人都说：万军的上主，以色列的天主，实在是以色列的天主。愿你仆人达味的家室，在你面前坚定不移！

text_en: For you, my God, have revealed to your servant that you will build a house for him; therefore your servant has found it possible to pray before you.
text_cn: 我的天主！因为是你启示你的仆人，要为他建立家室，因此，你的仆人才敢在你面前如此祈祷。

text_en: And now, O Lord , you are God, and you have promised this good thing to your servant;
text_cn: 上主！惟独你是天主！是你向你仆人应许了这些恩惠。

text_en: therefore may it please you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you. For you, O Lord , have blessed and are blessed forever. ”
text_cn: 现在，就请你惠然祝福你仆人的家室，使它永远在你面前存立。上主！因为凡你祝福的，必永远获得祝福。”
